The contents of the data is user defined Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Callback is called by Dlt to inject a function call in the SW - C. The behaviour trigged by this function should depend on the service_ id also the interpretation of the user data. Both are specific to the application. Available via Dlt.h
